verdict.rationale: Profiling and data-oriented scaling are fair questions for a game engine, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions a profiler, ECS, a job system, or instancing. A generic marketing line about 'performant 2D' does not show any of these capabilities.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can profile and scale — a real profiler, plus data-oriented paths (ECS, jobs, instancing) when scenes get heavy
